descripcion_geo: Oasis in the Zin desert, south of Negev. Israel's main camp during the desert pilgrimage.
importancia_estrategica: Israel's base of operations in the desert for almost forty years; starting point of the spies sent to Canaan.

historias.titulo: The twelve spies sent from Kadesh
historias.descripcion: Moses sends twelve spies from Kadesh to reconnoitre Canaan; Ten bring a negative report and the people despair.

historias.titulo: The water of Meribah in Kadesh
historias.descripcion: The people murmur for lack of water; Moses hits the rock instead of speaking to it and God forbids him from entering Canaan.
Miriam, the sister of Moses and prophetess of Israel, dies and is buried in Kadesh.

personajes.descripcion: In Kadesh he made the mistake that prevented him from entering Canaan; He spent years of pilgrimage here.
She died and was buried in Kadesh; He led the song of victory after crossing the Red Sea.
One of the two spies who trusted God upon returning from exploring Canaan from Kadesh.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Desert oasis where Israel spent most of his forty years of pilgrimage; place of failures and fidelities.

judaismo.descripcion: God makes water flow from the rock in the desert (Ex 17 and Num 20); symbol of divine provision in dryness.
judaismo.significado_teologico: God makes water flow from the rock in the desert (Ex 17 and Num 20); symbol of divine provision in dryness.

cristianismo.fuente_primaria: Nuevo Testamento / Padres de la Iglesia
cristianismo.descripcion: Paul interprets the rock in the desert as a figure of Christ: 'the rock was Christ' (1 Cor 10:4).
cristianismo.significado_teologico: Paul interprets the rock in the desert as a figure of Christ: 'the rock was Christ' (1 Cor 10:4).

islam.descripcion: The miracle of water in the desert also appears in the Islamic tradition about Musa (Moses).
islam.significado_teologico: The miracle of water in the desert also appears in the Islamic tradition about Musa (Moses).
